EN 
 Plastics technician - Enviro Tech About Enviro Tech, a company within the Axon Group 
Enviro Tech, based in Echt, specialises in the installation of plastic pipes, the manufacture of plastic structures, and the construction of plastic equipment, amongst other things. 
As far as possible, the preparatory work is carried out in-house at the workshop in Echt, whilst the final installation at the customer's premises is, of course, carried out on site. 
The Axon Group combines leading expertise and cutting-edge technologies in the fields of water and air treatment, powder coating and noise control. With 10 specialist companies, our group offers innovative, high-quality solutions tailored to a wide range of industries. 
 About this role 
As a plastics technician, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on high-quality work, customer satisfaction and teamwork. You will share responsibility for installing plastic piping, building equipment, and more… 
Our group offers plenty of opportunities for personal and professional development. You will work independently but also collaborate closely with colleagues across the organisation. 
 Your responsibilities - You are proficient in the technique of plastic welding (pipes and sheets) - You can read plans and translate them into construction - You weld and assemble components into system solutions. - You are responsible for the final conformity of the welds and structures and carry out the necessary finishing operations. - You are able to prepare the joint and position the parts, pipes or profiles. Your profile - You have experience as a plastics welder - A hands-on approach - You have a very good command of Dutch. Communication skills in English are an advantage. - Certifications such as VCA are an advantage. - You are independent, communicative and meticulous. - Thanks to your team-oriented mindset, you work well with your colleagues.
